description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 U1; T-2851's whole-line shapes): a whole-row range under one delete_row of rows 7-8 (count 2), across the last edge of the range: does S!4:7 shrink to S!4:6 (sum 28)? S!B2:B9 hold 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128 (so the sum names the rows read) and S!D12 holds =SUM(4:7), a whole-row range on its own sheet in a cell the delete moves. Sheet F holds A1 =SUM(S!4:7), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =SUM(S!$4:$7), A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =SUM(S!5:5) (one whole row), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), A7 =S!D12 and A8 =FORMULATEXT(S!D12) (the references follow the moved cell).
